svg.title: General Arrangement Plot Plan — Irregular-site Bulk Liquid Hydrocarbon Terminal (DT-UI-SVG-DOC-001)
svg.desc: Irregular plot traced from a reference survey; 1 SVG unit = 0.2 m. Layers per AIA CAD / ISO 13567; ISA-101 semantic zoom classes dt-zoom-l2 / dt-zoom-l3; ISO 14224 data binding on equipment.

g.text: BUND DATA (NFPA 30 · 110 % OF LARGEST TANK · SHELL SPACING ≥ D/6 · WALL CLEARANCE ≥ 1.5 m)
B-01 TF1 largest TK-0105 V = 6,973 m³ → 110 % = 7,670 m³ H req. 2.20 m → wall H 2.4 m · net 8,374 m³
B-02 TF2 largest TK-0201 V = 1,954 m³ → 110 % = 2,150 m³ H req. 1.37 m → wall H 1.6 m · net 2,513 m³
B-03 TF3 largest TK-0301 V = 985 m³ → 110 % = 1,084 m³ H req. 0.29 m → wall H 1.0 m · net 3,709 m³
B-04 TF4 largest TK-0401 V = 1,131 m³ → 110 % = 1,244 m³ H req. 0.85 m → wall H 1.1 m · net 1,609 m³
B-05 TF4-FR largest TK-0407 V = 1,946 m³ → 110 % = 2,141 m³ H req. 1.92 m → wall H 2.1 m · net 2,345 m³
Fillet R = 4.4 m at internal junctions (narrow corridors); perimeter road corners R = 15 m + half-width where edges allow.
Underground drains / OWS lines not shown. Sumps drain to the retention basin (zone 7).
MCR BLD-MCR-01 MAIN CONTROL ROOM (MCR) — Control: whole terminal
FAR BLD-FAR-01 FIELD AUXILIARY ROOM (FAR) / RACK ROOM — Control: tank farms 3 & 4, manifold
HV SUB BLD-SUB-01 MAIN HV SUBSTATION — Power: incoming supply, MV distribution
MCC-1 BLD-MCC-01 MCC-1 (TANK FARMS 1 & 2) — Power: TF1 / TF2 mixers, valves, sumps
MCC-2 BLD-MCC-02 MCC-2 (TANK FARM 3) — Power: TF3 valves, sumps, lighting
MCC-3 BLD-MCC-03 MCC-3 (TANK FARM 4 + PUMPS) — Power: TF4, pump station, gantry
WH-01 BLD-WH-01 MAIN MAINTENANCE WAREHOUSE — Storage: spares, tools, workshop
WH-02 BLD-WH-02 CONSUMABLES / LUBE STORAGE — Storage: lubricants, additives, PPE
FWPH BLD-FWP-01 FIRE-WATER PUMP HOUSE — Fire: ring main
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT — PLOT PLAN · BULK LIQUID HYDROCARBON TERMINAL
LAYERS: L-CIVIL · L-STRUCT · L-MECH · L-PIPE · L-FIRE · L-ANNO
SEMANTIC ZOOM: L1 macro · L2 secondary · L3 micro
